died.name: R. Stanton Walker
died.cause: The 20-year-old was watching an amateur baseball game in Morristown, Ohio when a foul ball struck him in the hand, driving a knife he was passing to one of his friends into his chest. His friends asked if he was hurt and he said "not much", but the wound soon began to bleed heavily and he died within minutes.

died.name: Alexander of Greece
died.cause: The 27-year-old Greek king died of sepsis after being bitten by a palace steward's pet Barbary macaque in his garden, while trying to break up a fight between his German shepherd and another monkey.

died.name: Albert Anastasia
died.cause: He was assassinated while in the barber's chair at the Park Sheraton Hotel in Midtown Manhattan
